caption: The drawing depicts a single, semi-transparent bowl placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The bowl is rendered in shades of light green and features delicate, evenly spaced, swirling patterns in a paler yellow or off-white color that follow the curvature of its surface. The bowl has a wide rim, gently flared and tapering downward to a small, circular base. The texture and coloration suggest a glass material, and the bowl is empty. The artist's signature, "VAN-SILVAY," appears near the lower right corner of the drawing. There are no additional objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Bowl
